query: select n.nspname as schema,p.proname,p.prosecdef,p.proconfig,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('public','private') and p.proname in ('is_admin','bump_comment_likes','bump_comment_replies','touch_streak','bump_feed_post_counters','handle_new_user','current_user_is_admin','can_view_buddy_read','can_view_reading_list','club_progress_counts') order by n.nspname,p.proname limit 30
